evidence_scope: Resource supplement only; completed normal/CPU prefix. Full monitor cost includes loading, gaps and stopped profile service; no profile-performance conclusions.

methods.ram: Host-wide MemTotal minus MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo, converted kB (KiB) / 1048576 to GiB. Availability accounts for estimated reclaimability; this is not model allocation size or exact physical resident attribution. MemFree/Cached/Buffers remain separate, and KReclaimable/SReclaimable overlap.
methods.overlap: No device, managed, RSS, cache or NVML values are added. All share or overlap physical RAM on Thor.
methods.windows: Sample-start membership in server-start through shutdown, and separately union of recorded request windows. Service windows include model loading and idle gaps. Boundary before/after samples are nearest by sample-start; each sample reads sources sequentially.
methods.clocks: CPU scaling_cur_freq kHz /1000; GPU/devfreq cur_freq Hz /1000000; thermal milli-Celsius /1000. Reported frequency samples are not kernel execution clocks or a time-integrated effective frequency.
methods.sampling: Approximately 1 Hz; short transients may be missed. Nearby boundary values are not exact endpoint measurements, simultaneous sensors, or causal attribution. No extrapolation to unmeasured work.

duration.semantics: Collection excludes serialization/write/flush. Whole cycle includes both; do not add them to whole cycle. These are monitor-thread wall intervals, not CPU utilization or measured inference overhead.

final_boundary.scope: Actual final sampled coverage is retained; it is not the skipped second-verify/fresh-barrier success protocol.
